Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

ExportVersion.description: Schema tag of an export report.

PythonExport.description: Generated reference source for one target and how its names map back to the model.

notes.description: Semantics the translation does not preserve, for readers.

reaction_aliases.description: Model reaction name to target name (`R0`, `R1`, … in declaration order).

source.description: Python module defining `build_model()`, with one frozen rate constant per channel and the target volume fixed at 1.

species_aliases.description: Model species name to target name (`S0`, `S1`, … in declaration order).

target_version.description: Exact target version the source checks for at run time.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

description: Result of `export`: success flag, model hash, the generated source and diagnostics.

artifact.description: The generated source on success, otherwise null; no partial source is emitted.

diagnostics.description: Validation findings, plus `CRN-E050` and `CRN-E051` for unsupported features.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes; null only when the model file could not be read.

simulation_available.description: Always false: export runs no simulation.

success.description: True when source was generated; then no error diagnostic is present.

title: ExportReport
